end.summary:
Practised showing numbers 11–20 as one ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified loose sticks as four in one example.
They counted a bundle as one item when finding the total.
They were unsure that the 1 in 15 represents one ten.
Teach-back was not passed; unaided correct attempts: 0/3.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making a ten-bundle and adding loose ones with Saanvi. Saanvi named four loose sticks correctly, and repeated “one ten,” but mixed up the bundle’s value with its visible count and read the 1 in 15 as one; this was not corrected by the last seen attempt. At home, use 10 small objects tied together plus loose objects and ask, “How many tens? How many ones? How many altogether?”
